Thank you — most of this is under-the-hood plumbing that I'll trust you on. The technology names don't mean much to me, but a couple of things I recognized reassured me: keeping each person's bookmarks private and behind their own login, being careful about how you go fetch a page's details safely, and giving me both a browser-friendly bookmark file and a full backup I can restore from. That all lines up with what I asked for.

I'm also glad you confirmed the as-you-type tag suggestions are written into what we agreed — that was my one loose end and it's handled.

As long as this plan delivers everything we settled on in the spec — the automatic title/description/icon, read-later, archive and restore, sorting, phrase and multi-tag search, and import/export — I'm happy for you to proceed. Please go ahead and break it into the actual task list.
